name: generative_mcp_fanout
summary: Meta-MCP whose tools all generate content by fanning out to existing infrastructure. generate_app→replit-bridge; generate_card→hf_hub structured-output; generate_code→deepseek-coder; generate_3d→autonomous_modeler; generate_image→comfyui_mcp; generate_video→studio_runtime._dispatch_remotion; generate_tweet→model_api.text+twitter.create_tweet. Every call crystal-anchors and registers as a new ops_dag node so recursive_workflows.detect_all surfaces the self-build motifs.

inputs.name: tool
inputs.notes: generate_app | generate_card | generate_code | generate_3d | generate_image | generate_video | generate_tweet | generate_dm

inputs.name: rate_limit_check
inputs.notes: MAX_GENERATIONS_PER_CYCLE=10 gate to prevent infinite expansion

outputs.name: produced_artifact
outputs.notes: URL | card_path | code_str | glb_path | image_path | tweet_id | etc.

passes.notes: Count generative_call rows in current cycle (~/.cc/cycle_<short>/generative_calls.jsonl). Reject when ≥ MAX_GENERATIONS_PER_CYCLE=10. Prevents runaway self-build.
Conditional on tool=='generate_card'. hf_hub.inference with structured-output prompt enforcing workflow_card_v0 schema. Writes to studio/assets/_workflows/<crystal>.workflow.v0.json.
Conditional on tool=='generate_app'. POSTs to replit-bridge port 8765. Same path as workflows.deploy.replit_to_droplet (this card delegates to that one).
Conditional on tool=='generate_code'. deepseek_mcp.chat_complete(model='deepseek-coder', ...). Returns code string.
Conditional on tool=='generate_3d'. Delegates to autonomous_modeler.run. Same convergence rules.
Conditional on tool=='generate_image'. comfyui_mcp.submit_workflow with flux_face_swap or generic txt2img template.
Conditional on tool=='generate_tweet'. model_api.text(prompt, model='deepseek-chat') → twitter.create_tweet. Requires TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN.
kind='generative_call'. next cc loop cycle picks it up; recursive_workflows.detect_all may surface generative→card→app→deploy motifs.
tier='generative', model='generative_mcp', scope=tool. coords=[artifact_bytes, fan_out_depth, cost_usd_estimate].
